# Svetlana Kochetova — Web Designer

> Independent freelance web designer and developer. Turnkey website design and development (landing pages, corporate sites, online stores, design-to-code) on Tilda, Webflow, WordPress, Framer, Wix, LPmotor and Shopify. Works with clients worldwide, in Russian and English. Working since 2019: 6+ years of experience, 400+ websites delivered, 250+ reviews.

Svetlana Kochetova is a private specialist, not an agency. The site is available in two languages with identical content: Russian (default) and English. Prices are "from" prices; the final cost is agreed per project.

## Services (English prices in USD, Russian prices in RUB)

- Landing page: from 10 days, from $400 (from 30,000 RUB). Custom design and responsive development, for ads, product launches or testing a niche.
- Corporate website: from 20 days, from $700 (from 50,000 RUB). Multi-page business site with a user-friendly CMS.
- Online store: from 20 days, from $900 (from 65,000 RUB). Catalog, cart, payments, delivery and admin panel.
- Design to code: from 1 day, from $150 (from 10,000 RUB). Responsive development from a ready Figma design.

## Platforms and skills

Web design, UX/UI, website development. Tilda, Webflow, WordPress, Framer, Wix, LPmotor, Shopify, Figma.
